derivation evidence

  • CURIE: gmeow:derivationEvidence
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationEvidence
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/lexicon
  • Box roles: CBox role, RBox role (What is this?)

The usage attestations, sources, or other evidence supporting a derivation claim. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a derivation may be supported by multiple evidence nodes, and evidence assessments vary by standpoint.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation -> gmeow:Entity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:derivationEvidence from gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation, gmeow:Entity

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use on an EtymologicalDerivation to attach the usage attestations, sources, or other evidence that support the derivation claim.

Avoid when

  • Avoid treating the evidence as proof of correctness (it supports, not settles, the claim) and avoid forcing a single evidence node — derivations may rest on several, so keep it non-functional.

How to use

  • Point gmeow:derivationEvidence at gmeow:UsageAttestation nodes, sources, or other gmeow:Entity evidence; carry the confidence the evidence warrants on the observation spine.

Examples

  • ex:etym1 gmeow:derivationEvidence ex:att1.
